# Project Profile: nepse-buy
<!-- Auto-generated by /init. Loaded on SessionStart. Do not edit manually. -->

## Stack
TypeScript / **Fastify 5** | (no web styling — mobile-only v1) | **Vitest** | PostgreSQL | Prisma 6
Mobile: Dart / Flutter / Riverpod / flutter_test
Infra: BullMQ + Redis (jobs), Resend (email), Docker Compose

> Note: fullstack-starter's README said Express + Jest but the actual code uses Fastify + Vitest. We inherit the actual stack.

## This Project Uses
- **Mobile UI** (Flutter + Riverpod + Clean Architecture)
- **API** (REST + Fastify + Zod validation + auto Swagger)
- **Database** (PostgreSQL + Prisma, append-only observation tables)
- **Auth** (JWT in httpOnly cookies, RBAC: USER + ADMIN)
- **Tests** (Vitest backend, flutter_test mobile)
- **Background jobs** (BullMQ + Redis, cron at 16:00 NPT)
- **Email delivery** (Resend transactional)
- **Web scraping** (nepalstock.com.np for prices, nepsealpha.com for fundamentals)

## This Project Does NOT Use
- **No Next.js / no web frontend** in v1 — mobile-only. SKIP web/SSR rules.
- **No FCM push notifications** in v1 — email + in-app feed only.
- **No broker order placement / TMS integration** — signal-only by design.
- **No day-trading indicators** (RSI/MACD) — explicitly out of scope.
- **No GraphQL** — REST only.
- **No microservices** — monolith.

- Test (backend): `npm test --workspace=core/backend` (Vitest)
- Test (mobile): `cd core/mobile && flutter test`
- Build (backend): `npm run build --workspace=core/backend`
- Build (mobile): `cd core/mobile && flutter build`
- Lint: `npm run lint`

- DB migrate (dev): `cd core/backend && npx prisma migrate dev`
- DB studio: `cd core/backend && npx prisma studio`

## Project-specific cautions
- **Append-only observation tables**: never UPDATE/DELETE `PriceObservation` or `FundamentalsObservation` rows. Insert new rows tagged with `source` + `fetched_at`.
- **Scraping fragility**: any change to source-site selectors should be detected and surface as a parser-confidence metric, not silently corrupt data.
- **Time zone**: schedule jobs in Asia/Kathmandu (NPT, UTC+5:45). NEPSE trades Sun–Thu, ~11:00–15:00 NPT.
- **NRS amounts**: store all monetary fields as integers in paisa (1 NPR = 100 paisa) or use decimal columns. Never floats.
